Mobile homes are common in the south. We have the expertise and tools required to reroof your mobile home.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text disabled_on=”off|off|off” _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Your roof protects the rafters and walls beneath it, as well as the rest of the building structure. So, if your roof leaks, you might be in for some serious difficulties that could cost you thousands of dollars to fix. You may easily prevent these issues by having Farris Roofing examine your home roof for free. We want to make sure your roof is in good condition and will survive beyond the manufacturer’s warranty period.

Aside from your roof protecting your home from the weather, it also can add beauty to your home and provide a strong selling point if you decide to sell. Typically, buyers check the age and condition of a roof on a home before putting out an offer. Keep your home’s roof in suitable condition for protecting your home and your investment if you go to sell.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

A good rule of thumb in Louisiana is if your roof hasn’t been replaced in at least 10 years, storms likely have caused damages that aren’t visible to the naked eye. By having us review your roof, you may minimize future roof repair expenditures. We have the knowledge and expertise to complete the task correctly the first time. Farris Roofing is a local leader in residential roofing and can assist you in determining if your roof has been damaged by storms in the past.

On tear offs and reroofing, we provide fast and quality installation. Residential roofing materials are available in a wide range of shapes and colors. We install appropriate roof coverage and overhang ventilation. We strive to leave your property in better condition than when we arrived.
